questions.q: As described in this lesson, which skill helps analysts build semantic models by suggesting relationships and generating calculated fields?
questions.explain: Data Pro supports semantic modeling with relationship suggestions and calculated field generation.

questions.q: Which skill is aimed at people asking business questions in natural language and getting visualizations back?
questions.explain: Concierge answers questions conversationally with interactive visualizations, aimed at consumers of analysis.

options: Monitors metrics and alerts people when something changes, such as a threshold or an unusual trend
questions.explain: Inspector is the monitoring and alerting skill. Trailhead labeled the proactive alerts capability beta at the time of writing.

questions.q: Why does the quality of the semantic model affect AI answers in Tableau Next?
options: It does not; AI ignores the semantic model
The assistant works with the names, relationships, and definitions the model provides, so poor definitions lead to confident but misleading answers
Semantic models make AI answers slower but identical
questions.explain: The model is the context the AI works from. Clear names, correct relationships, and one definition per metric improve results.

questions.q: Which habit does the lesson recommend before presenting an AI-generated number?
options: Ask the assistant to confirm its own answer twice
Check the definition behind it and reproduce one headline figure from a trusted source
questions.explain: Treat AI output as a starting point. Verify the measure definition and cross-check a headline number before sharing.
